• Experience supporting Windows and Linux operating systems in cloud-hosted environments.

• Working knowledge of AMI image creation and lifecycle processes.

• Ability to write clear technical documentation, runbooks, implementation notes, and operational standards.

• Strong technical, process, and problem-solvingproficiencywith the ability to work independently on complex operational issues.

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to partner with engineers, Cloud Architects, Security, Product, Business Management, and other stakeholders.

• AWS Certified Solutions Architect,SysOpsAdministrator, DevOps Engineer, Kube

• Support reconciliation, performance optimisation and production-readiness activities.

• Strong software engineering experience designing and developing transaction-processing, orchestration or settlement solutions.

• Experience integrating complex systems through APIs, messaging, event-driven architectures or comparable integration patterns.

• Experience integrating digital-cash or tokenised-cash settlement capabilities.

About Faire

Faire is a technology wholesale platform built on the belief that the future is local. Independent retailers around the globe collectively represent a multi-hundred-billion-dollar wholesale market that has historically been fragmented and offline. At Faire, we're using the power of tech, data, and machine learning to connect this thriving community of entrepreneurs across the globe. Picture your favorite boutique in town - we help them discover the best products from around the world to sell in their stores. With the right tools and insights, we believe that we can level the playing field so businesses can grow and local communities can thrive.

We’re looking for smart, resourceful and passionate people to join us as we power the shop local movement. If you believe in community, come join ours.

About this role

Personalization is one of the highest-leverage product areas at Faire: the recommendation systems and ranking models that decide what every retailer sees across our home page, brand catalogs, and more. We're looking for a Product Manager to own this space end-to-end - someone who can go deep on the technical tradeoffs behind our recommendation systems, work shoulder-to-shoulder with ML engineers, and turn that into a roadmap that improves experiences for retailers and moves the business.

This role starts as full ownership of Personalization, then grows. Once you've built context and made the case for how the scope should split, you'll hire a second Personalization PM and grow into the product lead role for this area.

What you'll do

• Own Personalization's roadmap and strategy end-to-end - the recommendation and ranking systems that power discovery across every surface retailers use.

• Build a deep understanding of retailer needs, discovery behaviors, and marketplace dynamics, and use qualitative and quantitative research to surface high-impact opportunities and frame problem statements the team can act on.

• Partner directly with ML engineers on model and system tradeoffs and improvements.

• Co-create roadmaps with data science, engineering, and other product partners so algo work and engineering work are sequenced together to deliver customer and business impact.

• Prioritize across the many collaboration and impact opportunities other teams bring to Personalization.

• Be directly accountable for ambitious goals that get visibility at the highest levels of the company.

• Build credibility with senior leadership as an expert on Faire's business and how the algorithms behind it impact our customers and business.

• Serve as a go-to product leader for ambiguous, high-stakes problems in Discovery algorithms space.

• Raise the bar on how our product and data science teams work together, especially as AI reshapes how that partnership operates day to day.

• Build the case for how Personalization's scope should split, then help hire and onboard a second PM to share it.

Qualifications

• 8+ years of product management experience, including senior IC or Staff-level ownership of a technical product area.

• Direct experience shipping recommendation, ranking, or personalization systems.

• Strong business judgment, with a track record of making tough prioritization calls across multiple stakeholder teams in order to delivery on ambitious goals.

• Experience splitting execution responsibility with partner teams on shared goals - defining who owns what and aligning roadmaps.

• Prior people-management experience is a plus, but not required.

title: Data Scientist
description:
GenLogs is a transportation-technology company building the next generation of truck intelligence. Through a nationwide network of sensors and proprietary data, we deliver real-time, high-fidelity insights into freight movement for commercial supply-chain customers and public-sector agencies. Our mission is to strengthen America’s logistics backbone, combat freight fraud and cargo theft, and provide near-instantaneous visibility into commercial motor vehicle activity across major freight corridors. By operating at the intersection of edge sensing, computer vision, AI-driven analytics, and large-scale field deployment, GenLogs is transforming how transportation data is captured, secured, and commercialized.
ABOUT THE DATA TEAM
The Data Science team at GenLogs transforms raw observational data from the Trident sensor network into high-value intelligence used by law-enforcement agencies, regulators, ports, and private-sector freight operators. We build models, analytics, and measurement frameworks that enable vehicle detection, entity resolution, behavioral insights, fraud and theft indicators, compliance signals, and network-wide operational performance metrics. Our work sits at the center of the freight intelligence platform, shaping how billions of roadside observations become actionable information. We partner closely with Engineering and Product to deploy algorithms at scale and with Go-to-Market teams to define customer-facing analyses that drive real operational outcomes. The team blends statistical rigor, ML capability, and domain expertise to create a new standard for freight intelligence in the United States.
ABOUT THE JOB
You’re a problem solver at heart. You thrive at the intersection of engineering, math, and machine learning , and you’re motivated by questions that don’t have obvious answers. You bring a background in engineering, computer science, physics, applied math, or another hard science discipline, and you enjoy applying that technical foundation to real-world ML challenges.
You are energized by ambiguity, obsessed with understanding how complex systems behave, and capable of breaking down big problems into tractable iterations. You ask great questions, validate assumptions with data, and are relentless in your pursuit of signal over noise.
WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Build machine-learning systems that power some of the most advanced logistics intelligence products in the industry

• Analyze large, noisy datasets from cameras, OCR, detections, and geospatial pipelines to uncover actionable patterns

• Design and evaluate algorithms for truck re-identification, geospatial clustering, equipment classification, OCR text labeling , anomaly detection, and more

• Collaborate with engineering and data engineering teams to scale models from prototype to production

• Work closely with product teams to deeply understand customer needs and translate them into modeling and analytics initiatives

• Apply scientific thinking to continuously test, iterate, and refine approaches as new data becomes available

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 2-5 years of professional experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, or Software Engineering

• Technical foundation in engineering, physics, math, computer science , or related applied fields

• Experience deploying or building models using:

•

•
Machine learning fundamentals (classification, clustering, time-series, anomaly detection)

•
Computer vision (OCR, object detection, embeddings)

•
Geospatial data analysis (mapping, clustering, location intelligence)

•
Association/sequence pattern mining , feature engineering, or algorithm development

• Experience working with cloud-based data tooling (Snowflake, AWS) - not required but nice to have

• Strong programming skills in Python and comfort with modern data/ML libraries (PyTorch, Pandas, Scikit-learn, etc.)

• Comfort working with real-world messy datasets (sensor data, imagery, telematics, transactional freight data)

title: AI and Cloud Security Engineer
description:
Overview
TD SYNNEX (NYSE: SNX) is the world's largest IT distributor, and we are accelerating AI adoption across Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, Copilot Studio, Databricks, and self-hosted agent environments. Our security philosophy is distinctive: rather than slowing innovation with pre-approval gatekeeping, we operate a runtime-first, default-allow security posture - every AI interaction is intercepted, analyzed, and enforced at the moment of execution. In our architecture, the traditional network perimeter no longer defines the defensive boundary: the AI agent is the perimeter.
The AI & Cloud Security team is chartered to make that vision operational. We are seeking senior technical owner of the AI security runtime control plane and detection fabric. You will build and integrate the inline enforcement pipeline (AI gateway → runtime data protection → intent-based enforcement), tune the policies that keep it fast and low-friction, and serve as the final escalation point for the most complex AI and cloud security incidents. You will also help implement and participate in operation of a closed-loop defensive system in which continuous red-team findings automatically improve runtime policies, detection logic, and SOC threat models. You join a team of two AI & Cloud Security Architects and will be the engineering force that turns strategy into operating controls - across a multi-cloud estate (Azure, AWS, GCP).
This role involves collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure the security of AI and cloud environments, AI applications and infrastructure, addressing potential threats, and maintaining compliance with regulatory standards. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in AI technologies and their implementation as well as cloud security, security principles and cybersecurity best practices. The ability to develop automation in both AI and cloud environments with infrastructure as code (IaC) or policy as code principles is required. The engineer will report to AI & Cloud Security leadership and have strong working relationships with IT and application development leadership.
Responsibilities

•
Integration - build and own the AI runtime control plane. Engineer, deploy and operate the inline enforcement pipeline for AI traffic: an AI gateway chained with runtime data-protection and intent-based enforcement platforms, fronting LLMs, tools, and MCP servers across Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, GCP Vertex, Copilot Studio, Databricks, and self-hosted environments.

•
Harden the gateway layer for resilience : configure buffering and overload management, enforcement timeouts on external-processing filters, layered global/local rate limiting, and prompt-truncation filters to defend against token-exhaustion and "reasoning overload" denial-of-service attacks.

•
Integrate the wider AI security ecosystem into one coherent system : onboard AI asset-intelligence context (agent inventory, ownership, blast radius) into enforcement decisions; connect model-security and supply-chain telemetry and continuous red-team signals into SIEM correlation and SOC workflows; stream unified AI detections, decision logs, and policy events for forensics and audit.

•
Policy tuning - enforce without friction. Author and calibrate runtime policies: prompt-injection and jailbreak prevention, PII detection/redaction and data masking, intent-based filtering, tool-call validation, MCP access control, and agent permission boundaries (including "lethal trifecta" prevention for low-code agents). Balance detection versus hard-block modes to minimize false positives, and tune per AI archetype - embedded SaaS copilots, democratized low-code agents, homegrown agentic pipelines, device-based coding agents, and homegrown models.

•
Operate the closed loop : translate continuous adversarial-testing findings into runtime policy updates, new detection content, and guardrail tuning, then validate remediation through re-testing - so defenses evolve with attacke

title: Senior Quality Engineer
description:
About StarRez

StarRez is the global leader in student housing software, providing innovative solutions for on and off-campus housing management, resident wellness and experience, and revenue generation. Trusted by 1,400+ clients across 25+ countries, StarRez supports more than 4 million beds annually with its user-friendly, all-in-one platform, delivering seamless experiences for students and administrators. With offices in the United States, Australia, the UK, and India, StarRez blends the robust capabilities of a global organization with the personalized care and service of a trusted partner.

About StarRez

StarRez is the global leader in student housing software, providing solutions for on- and off-campus housing management, resident wellness and experience, and revenue generation. Trusted by 1,400+ clients across 25+ countries, StarRez supports more than 4 million beds annually. With offices in the United States, Australia, the UK, and India, StarRez blends the capabilities of a global organisation with the personalised care of a trusted partner.

The Role

StarRez Go is our staff-facing mobile companion to the main platform, used by housing staff to run inspections, check residents in and out, manage maintenance and look up resident information from the field, running on iOS and Android phones and tablets.

You will be the quality owner for the Go app. Your end users are staff on rounds, often on shared devices, using the camera and ID scanning, and handling student data. A failure in the field means a stalled check-in line or a missed inspection, so your quality approach will need to account for the end user

This is a hands-on role; you will not manage people. You will set the quality bar for the mobile team, do the work to hold it, and coach your peers in quality practices so that quality is baked in at every stage. The goal is a team that builds quality in, not a QA who inspects for it.

What You Will Own

•
Own the end-to-end test strategy for the StarRez Go app

•
You will set the quality bar for the mobile team, coach your peers in quality practices so that quality is baked in at every stage and raise it early when quality is slipping.

•
Champion StarRez’s quality standards and advocate for quality throughout the software delivery lifecycle.

•
Design and execute validation strategies for feature-related initiatives.

•
Partner with Product, Design and Engineering from ideation through delivery to ensure acceptance criteria, personas, customer journeys, test data, edge cases, non-functional expectations, and quality gates reflect real user operations and the intended product experience

•
Decide what is automated, manual and exploratory, and be able to defend each decision.

•
Own backward compatibility: older app versions remain in the field after a release. Define and test version support.

•
Apply AI tools and techniques to improve product quality and enhance the effectiveness and efficiency of quality engineering practices and processes.

Required Qualifications

•
5+ years in software or quality engineering, with a deep focus on quality in complex systems.

•
Hands-on experience testing native or cross-platform mobile apps on iOS and Android, including tablets.

•
Experience testing mobile apps used in field or operational settings.

•
Experience testing APIs and back-end services and the integration between a mobile client and its back end.

•
Solid understanding of the testing pyramid, and of when UI automation and manual testing are each appropriate.

•
Experience with cloud device farms or third-party testing platforms, and judgement about when outsourced tooling is the right choice.

•
Practical experience with CI/CD pipelines and release quality gates, including test suite selection and environment readiness.

•
Ability to turn customer needs into well-defined user stories, acceptance criteria and risk-based test scenarios.

•
Practical experience using AI in software development, with sound judgement

title: Consumer Product Communications Lead
description:

About the Role

You’ll develop a clear narrative for our consumer products and bring it to life through compelling launches, useful demonstrations, and stories about how people use AI in their everyday lives.

You’ll build momentum between announcements, finding fresh ways to reach new audiences while earning the trust of the people who use our products most deeply.

This role calls for a hands-on communications leader with strong editorial judgment, creative ambition, and the ability to turn ideas into results. You’ll have a clear point of view, work with substantial autonomy, and build close partnerships across the company.

In this role, you will:

- Own the communications strategy and narrative for ChatGPT and consumer-facing products, connecting product developments to what matters to users.

- Lead product launches from strategy through execution, including positioning, messaging, media outreach, spokesperson preparation, and follow-through.

- Develop proactive campaigns that show how people use our products to learn, create, and solve everyday problems.

- Partner closely with Product, Research, Engineering, Marketing, Design, Legal, and other communications teams to shape plans, resolve tradeoffs, and communicate accurately.

- Build relationships with consumer and technology journalists, creators, and other voices who help people understand new technology.

- Direct the consumer communications agency partner, setting priorities, writing clear briefs, giving useful feedback, and holding the team accountable for quality and results.

- Write and edit launch materials, pitches, talking points, and other communications with a high standard for clarity, accuracy, and originality.

- Anticipate questions and concerns, bring audience feedback into planning, and assess whether campaigns improve understanding and earn trust.

You might thrive in this role if you:

- Expressing strong perspective / conviction / confidence / love writing narrative / influence

- Strong management skills

- Have a strong track record leading communications for consumer technology products, including major launches and proactive campaigns.

- Can turn complex product capabilities into clear, compelling stories without losing accuracy or overstating what the technology can do.

- Combine strategic judgment with hands-on execution and are as comfortable developing a narrative as writing a pitch or preparing a spokesperson.

- Build trusted relationships across functions, influence decisions, and help teams reach a clear direction when perspectives differ.

- Bring creative ideas and strong editorial taste. You can explain why a story, demo, or campaign will resonate and make the work better through specific feedback.

- Take initiative, make sound decisions independently, and stay organized in a fast-moving environment.

- Have experience managing agency partners and getting excellent work from a combined internal and external team.

title: CRM Manager
locationText: Denmark, Estonia, Finland, Latvia, Lithuania, Netherlands, Spain
description:
At Bondora , our mission is simple: to make finance easy, transparent, and accessible for everyone.

Founded in 2008, we’ve helped more than 700,000 customers across Europe borrow and invest effortlessly through our trusted digital products.

As a rapidly growing financial technology company, we’re reaching new heights with a bold vision. We’re set to acquire a banking license, unlocking a world of possibilities for our customers. This transition will allow us to expand our lending across more EU countries and broaden our product suite to deliver even more value.

Join us on this journey and let’s build the future of finance together!

What is this role about? 🚀
As a CRM Manager , you build and run the customer journeys that guide Bondora ’s customers through their whole lifecycle: from their first loan application and onboarding, to repeat loans and add-ons, to the moments when repayments get difficult. You’ll be one of three CRM Managers in Bondora ’s CRM & Customer Value team, reporting to the Head of CRM & Customer Value. Our CRM runs on Braze, with unusually rich customer and loan data and value signals already flowing in. You’ll decide what to build by its value in loans and euros, prove what works against holdout groups, and treat every customer fairly: a loan is a financial decision, not a shopping cart.
Your main responsibilities 🎯

• Build and run customer journeys in Braze across the lifecycle: application and onboarding, repeat loans and add-ons, reactivation, and payment difficulty, with QA before every launch and zero customer-facing errors.

• Design journeys around the customer’s situation: triggers, timing, cadence, channels and fallback, stop rules, and handovers to self-service, a human or another journey.

• Prove what works: build a control or holdout into every journey and report results as business outcomes (signed loans, revenue, arrears), not opens or clicks.

• Prioritise by value: size opportunities in loans and euros before building, and rank your work by value rather than volume.

• Own compliance and risk suppression: classify messages correctly, respect consent, never send commercial messages to customers showing payment risk, and involve Legal and Risk before launch.

• Keep the data reliable: validate events and attributes, fix journeys that act on wrong or late data, and escalate upstream issues with evidence.

• Move legacy communications into Braze and work through the team’s shared rules: one intake route for requests, and clean handovers with the other CRM Managers.

What would ensure success in this role?💪

• 5+ years of hands-on experience in CRM or lifecycle marketing. Experience in lending, fintech or recurring-revenue businesses is a plus.

• Hands-on production experience in Braze or a comparable platform (Iterable, Customer.io, Salesforce Marketing Cloud): journeys, segmentation, event and API triggers, dynamic content and QA. You build it yourself, not through an agency.

• Experience designing journeys for different lifecycle stages, built around the customer’s situation rather than a fixed sequence.

• Experimentation literacy: you design tests with holdouts, read business outcomes rather than open rates, and can pull your own data (SQL or a product analytics tool).

• Commercial judgment: you can estimate what an improvement is worth in loans and euros and decide what to build first.

• Sound compliance judgment: transactional vs. promotional messages, consent, and responsible treatment of customers in a credit business.

• A habit of checking data before trusting it, and of fixing problems at the root.

• Working expertise in email, SMS and WhatsApp, with modular, localisable content for several markets.

• A habit of using AI to speed up QA and analysis, with the judgment to know when not to trust it.

• High ownership and a bias to action: you’d rather ship something good this week than something perfect next quarter, and you drive conversations with Product, Engineering,

title: Claims Examiner II
description:
POSITION SUMMARY
Process insurance claims for property losses based on coverage, appraisal, and verifiable damage. Interact with independent adjusters and policy holders, review claim forms and other records to determine insurance coverage. Make payment recommendations and settlements in accordance with company practices, procedures, and Fair Claims Settlement Practices regulations.
PRINCIPAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
• Investigate, evaluate, and resolve claims, applying technical knowledge and human relations skills to promote fair and prompt settlement of claims.
• Adjust reserves and provide reserve recommendations to ensure reserving activities are consistent with company policies.
• Enter claim transactions, in a clear and concise manner.
• Examine claims inspected by independent adjusters, including further investigation of questionable claims, verification of coverage, and timely issuance of payments to policyholders.
• Conduct daily diary reviews on claim files to ensure status letters are sent to policyholders in accordance with Department of Insurance regulations.
• Pay and process claims within designated authority level.
• Supervise independent adjusters to ensure adherence to CFP IA Guidelines.
• Maintain compliance with the Department of Insurance and Company policy and procedures.
• Create correspondence to policyholders that is accurate and complete. Communicate with insureds and/or others involved to secure missing information.
• Promptly negotiate settlements, making sure that the settlement reflects the actual insured losses while ensuring that the insurer is protected from invalid claims.
• Confer with Claims Management and legal counsel on claims involving litigation.

ADDITIONAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
This role may include handling the entire claim (except inspection), or may be responsible for a specific coverage, such as Personal Property or Fair Rental Value. This role will focus on claims ranging from $100,000 to $300,000 in damages, but the Claims Examiner II may receive larger or smaller claims when necessary.
EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE
• Minimum bachelor’s degree or equivalent preferred.
• Excellent oral and written communication skills.
• Working experience with MS-Office (especially Word and Excel) is required.
• 2 + years property claims experience and excellent customer service.
• Certified in CEA and Fair Claims Settlement Practices.
• 3 years total claims experience, 2 years handling HO claims up to $300,000
• 1 year Carrier Experience Required

Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. 役割

セールスと市場開拓（Go-to-Market）部門の一員としてご活躍いただける、アカウント エグゼクティブを募集しています。この職務は日本を拠点とし、リージョナルディレクター直属となります。

title: Director, Product Finance (Devices)
description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Your Impact

You will collaborate across the finance organization and with key business leaders to drive process improvement, strategic decisions and enhance Axon’s forecasting and analysis capabilities. You will support a fast paced and dynamic business team that is working on solving the most challenging problems for our customers.

You will join an environment that favors agility, initiative and creative thinking. We genuinely love what we do and are looking for you who share this passion. Come work with us in a dynamic environment in which you’ll use your passion, technical experience, and strong problem-solving skills.

Location: In office presence at one of our US Hubs - San Francisco, NYC, Boston, Atlanta, Sterling,  Seattle, or Scottsdale. This role follows a hybrid schedule. We rely on in-person collaboration and ask that team members work onsite Tuesdays through Fridays, with the flexibility to work remotely on Mondays, unless there is an approved workplace accommodation. We believe that connection fuels innovation, and our in-office culture is designed to foster meaningful teamwork, mentorship, and shared success.

What You’ll Do

• You will apply business and financial acumen to support various levels of Operational and Financial decision makers with data, analysis, metrics, process creation/improvement and operating model alignment

• You will support Product Roadmap prioritization based on profit contribution and engineering resource constraints in close partnership with engineering and product leads

• You will model new product design iterations and develop the business case for new products and features based on product-market fit and expected cost reduction

• You will drive regular cost reduction, headcount, and budget reviews to ensure alignment to the company plan and product strategy

• You will support the corporate forecasting process for R&D/product spend and present results to R&D leaders. Regularly participate in corporate FP&A meetings such as executive corporate forecast reviews and budget vs. actuals reviews

• You will support the company-wide Strategic Portfolio Planning Process by assisting in the creation of Investment Business Cases for new Products & Strategic initiatives and in doing so the role will collaborate cross functionally and will have full P&L exposure

• The position will also support Product teams in their holistic analysis of market and P&L performance for key Product Segments and contribute with data, KPIs and analysis

What You Bring

• Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration or Financial Accounting

• Minimum of 7 years of experience in financial modeling, forecasting and business analytics in a dynamic environment, supporting both financial and operational decision makers

• Proven track record of owning projects and driving their completion cross-functionally

• Experience driving process improvements focused on quality, timeliness and improved efficiency

• Ability to working independently with concern for quality and deadlines

• Data analysis and dynamic scenario modeling with emphasis on researching and validating modeling inputs and assumptions and ensuring their alignment with operational models and strategic goals

• Technology/software/SaaS industry experience, Hardware exposure preferred

• Manufacturing experience

• Excellent analytical, oral and written communication skills

title: Senior eDiscovery Analyst
description:
Fish & Richardson, the premier global intellectual property law firm, is trusted by the world’s most innovative and influential companies. Fish was established in 1878, and now has more than 400 attorneys and technology specialists in the U.S., Europe, and China. Our success is rooted in our creative and inclusive culture, which values the diversity of people, experiences, and perspectives. Join Fish’s team in our fast-paced Litigation Department as a Senior eDiscovery Analyst . This role is part of The Hub, Fish’s remote-first group of professionals. Hub employees work primarily from home with no expectation of a regular in-office presence. This is a remote-first position, with a focus on candidates in GA, TX, MA, IL, DE, MN, NY, and DC.
Internal applicants: apply via UKG Pro by navigating to Myself > My Company> View opportunities.
How Will You Make a Difference?

• Consult case teams and client representatives on best practices surrounding the preservation, collection, processing, analysis, review, and production of ESI.

• Utilize software tools (e.g. Relativity Analytics, and Active Learning / continuous active learning (CAL)) to reduce the size of potentially relevant data sets.

• Work with case teams, client representatives, and vendors to devise and implement plans to preserve, collect, process, review, and produce ESI in a defensible manner.

• Develop and maintain documentation surrounding ESI analysis and document review plans (e.g., reviewer statistics, responsiveness metrics, error logs).

• Accurately maintain and support the eDiscovery applications used by the firm.

• Design and create databases containing discovery data and other ESI.

• Process and troubleshoot ESI; manipulate and load data.

• Update, organize, and maintain logs, reports, and other project management materials.

• Research and troubleshoot a wide variety of electronic discovery issues and recommend technical solutions.

• Research and stay up to date on relevant software and technology solutions to ensure effective client support.

• Maintain advanced technical and professional knowledge of applications, equipment, and related topics through training, vendor meetings, seminars, vendor materials, documentation, self-study, internal and external user group meetings, industry networking, and professional journals.

• Design, execute, and validate AI-assisted review workflows using the Relativity aiR suite (including aiR for Review and aiR for Privilege, and where applicable aiR for Case Strategy and aiR for Data Breach Response) - drafting and iterating natural-language prompts/issue descriptions, sampling and quality-checking model output, and documenting a defensible validation protocol.

• Serve as a subject-matter resource for generative AI and analytics tools, mentoring analysts and advising case teams on the appropriate use, limitations, and defensibility of AI-assisted review.

• Process and review data from cloud and collaboration sources. (e.g., Microsoft 365 / Purview, Google Workspace, Slack, and Microsoft Teams).

What Will You Bring to the Table?

• A minimum of 5 years’ experience across litigation, investigations, and regulatory matters with significant working knowledge of document review technologies (e.g., RelativityOne, Active Learning/technology assisted review, and generative AI review tools).

• Relativity Certified Administrator certification is required for the Senior level.

• Relativity Analytics Specialist and Relativity Processing Specialist certifications are preferred; Relativity aiR and other AI-related credentials are preferred as they become available.

• eDiscovery vendor-side experience such as processing, hosting or vendor project management background is preferred.

• Understanding of the ESI life cycle and related industry standards.

• Strong customer service and interpersonal communication skill set accompanied by excellent written and oral communication skills and demonstrated team-building capabilities
